owner_decision_required:
VQ2-A2 was NOT created. Both construction inputs it depends on failed measurement.

1 APPROVED LOGO — §2 requires a clean MANUAL vector reconstruction. I cannot perform one: that means a human designer redrawing the mark in Illustrator. What I can do is automated contour extraction, and I measured it honestly. Seven of nine components reach >=0.96 IoU, but REGISTERED_RING reaches 0.62 and R_STEM 0.92. The registered symbol is precisely an element §2 requires preserved; shipping it 38% wrong would be an accidental redesign of a registered mark. Options: (A) commission a manual vector redraw, (B) obtain the original vector logo from the brand owner, (C) accept an automated reconstruction with the measured per-component IoU on record.

2 CUSTOM LETTERING — every one of the 13 glyphs failed the 0.95 threshold (range 0.639-0.920). The cause is source resolution, not method: the product name is only 40-75 px of cap height in the photograph, and a high-contrast Didone's hairlines and serif brackets are 1-2 px there, at or below the render noise floor. One glyph degenerated to 20 contours and 214 nodes, which is noise rather than a letterform. No amount of tolerance tuning recovers detail the source does not contain. Options: (A) supply a higher-resolution render or the original artwork, (B) licence a condensed Didone, (C) commission manual lettering.

Delivered regardless: the owner brand ruling, the two-authority separation (which unblocks concept-front width and confines the flat-width blocker to production artwork), the full per-component and per-glyph feasibility evidence, and the M3 freeze verification.
